findings.evidence: Lines 98-102 vs 165-169 and 107-109 vs 174-176; `zsmul_eq_mul` confirmed in mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Periodic.lean:162.
findings.fix: Prove it once next to the general lemmas in `TauCeti/RingTheory/DividedPowers/Associative.lean`: a shifted-form corollary `x * y ^ n = y ^ n * (x + ((n : ℤ) * c : A))` (and the `dividedPower` analogue), via `zsmul_eq_mul` and `mul_add`. Each of the four sl₂ lemmas then becomes a single `push_cast`/`simpa` specialisation, and it supplies the general Cartan-conjugation statement `H * X ^ n = X ^ n * (H + n * c)` the PR description advertises but the file does not contain (no `h_mul_pow_of_lie_eq_zsmul` exists: `grep -rn 'h_mul_pow_of_lie_eq_zsmul' code/TauCeti` returns nothing).
findings.issue: `h_mul_f_pow` (98-102), `h_mul_e_pow` (107-109), `h_mul_f_dividedPower` (165-169) and `h_mul_e_dividedPower` (174-176) are four copies of the same proof: a `(±2 : ℤ) • _` restatement, an `hc` cast lemma, then `rw [..., hc, (neg_zsmul,) natCast_zsmul, mul_sub/mul_add, nsmul_eq_mul']`. findings.issue: `inv_factorial_succ_nsmul` is a `private` lemma in an sl₂-specific file, but it is generic divided-power arithmetic (`((n+1)! : ℚ)⁻¹ • ((n+1) • x) = (n! : ℚ)⁻¹ • x`) with no sl₂ content and no `Ring` requirement — it is the same cancellation that every further normal-ordering lemma (`E⁽ᵐ⁾ F⁽ⁿ⁾`) will need, hidden where nothing else can use it.

summary: The four Cartan-conjugation lemmas repeat one identical zsmul-to-cast normalisation chain verbatim instead of factoring it, and the core induction step relies on a seven-lemma ordered `rw` chain plus a `private` helper that buries a reusable divided-power arithmetic fact.
